card.name: Section numbers in highlights headings
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts a number with a decimal point, such as the 4 in (4.1) or the 2 in (2.1). Mostly in label highlights section cross-references, and also in table numbers and measurements.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The leading digit of a section reference in parentheses after a heading such as Contraindications or Dosage.

modes.label: Table and measurement numbers
modes.description: A leading digit in a table number, size or amount, before a decimal or further digits.
modes.example: gram vial 3 3.6 280 Intravenous 1 gram vial 10 10.8* <<1>>00 2 gram vial

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a section number like 4.1 in the short summary at the top of a drug label.
